name: CartDrawer
deprecation_reason: CartDrawer is retained only for legacy pages; new pages must use the Cart V2 profile.
usage_hint: DEPRECATED (Cart V1). Cart V2 is enabled by default and the renderer injects the effective profile automatically. CartDrawer remains only for existing legacy pages during migration.
when_to_use: NEVER on new pages. Only keep CartDrawer while migrating an existing legacy page that already contains it.
when_not_to_use: Any new page. Any page using the default profile-driven Cart V2 runtime.
combine_with: Legacy pages only. New pages use a published effective Cart V2 profile without an authored cart section or enable flag.
anti_patterns: Using CartDrawer on a new page: deprecated — profile-driven Cart V2 is already the default
Adding CartDrawer beside the effective Cart V2 profile: dual cart surfaces, publish validation fails
Multiple CartDrawer instances: creates state conflicts
